dedupe_keys.name: rhomis rural household multiple indicator survey data from 13 310 farm households in 21 countries

description: A harmonised farm household survey dataset from low and middle income countries. The Scientific Data paper (11 February 2020) says RHoMIS is a standardised survey covering 758 variables on household demographics, farm area, crops and livestock and their production and use, and socio-economic and food security indicators such as the Probability of Poverty Index and household dietary diversity, from which more than 40 indicators are computed, and that it was applied to 13,310 households in 21 countries in Central America, sub-Saharan Africa and Asia between 2015 and early 2018. Raw responses, indicator code and indicator values are a free download on Harvard Dataverse (doi 10.7910/DVN/9M6EHS); the paper is under CC BY. Coverage is the 21 study countries. Caveats: samples come from project sites, not national frames. For simulation it gives farm household structure and food security, to parameterise models of rural resilience to climate shocks. A related catalogue record is the World Bank LSMS-ISA surveys.
